data.gender_notes: Fortune is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'fortuna', meaning 'luck' or 'fortune'. In ancient Rome, Fortuna was the goddess of fortune, luck, and prosperity. In Christianity, the name Fortuna represents the spiritual blessing and divine guidance that comes from God. The name Fortune carries the meaning “Good fortune, prosperity” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fortune usually hope their child will grow to embody good fortune, prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of God's divine providence and blessings.
data.etymology: Fortune belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Good fortune, prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fortune total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fortuna was common among early Christians, particularly among those who believed in the providence of God. It served as a reminder of God's protection and care in the face of uncertainty and the unpredictability of life. Fortuna was also a popular name among the nobility and the wealthy, as it conveyed a sense of good fortune and prosperity.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian theology, the name Fortuna takes on a deeper spiritual meaning. It symbolizes the idea that true fortune and prosperity come not from worldly possessions or luck, but from the grace and mercy of God. In Romans 4:17, St. Paul writes, "So he who had no promise received the promise according to the determination of His will, that the word of the promise might be confirmed, not by the law as the law was to Abraham or to his offspring, but by the righteousness of faith." In this way, Fortuna is a reminder of the importance of faith and trust in God's plan for our lives.
